subject.title: refactor(prompt): use plain inbound context labels and drop system-tag sanitizer

question: Should queued system-event text continue to neutralize nested system-style markers independently of the cosmetic inbound-label rename, and should released transcript labels be migrated before changing the runtime sentinel format?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes both behaviors, but those are security and persisted-session compatibility contracts rather than mechanical formatting choices.

options.title: Preserve boundaries and migrate
options.body: Restore structural sanitization at system-event queue writes and add a Doctor migration plus upgrade coverage for released transcript labels.

options.title: Accept the clean break
options.body: Explicitly accept forged-looking nested system text and historical session replay changes as intentional compatibility and security policy changes.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: Land only the label rename after extracting the sanitizer-removal and stored-session policy decisions into separately reviewed work.

recommendation.title: Preserve boundaries and migrate
recommendation.body: Restore structural sanitization at system-event queue writes and add a Doctor migration plus upgrade coverage for released transcript labels.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch centralizes the affected prompt-boundary changes and is best positioned to separate the cosmetic refactor from the security and migration decisions.
